_about: The self-recall count for City College of San Francisco report 28 (kb/_course_outcomes_read.py rows_recall), round 2 (second reader on #3601). Report 28 names curriculum staff, so the trial filed no page (d-ccsf-outline-trial-no-staff-names-s689). Each count comes from the page itself: the trial printed each page's SLO section, cut by its STUDENT LEARNING OUTCOMES and CONTENTS headings alone, to its job log, and the worker counted the printed lines by eye, the lead not counted. The sandbox and the web fetch tool cannot reach ccsf.curricunet.com, so the runner's reading is the only one. No page prints an objectives heading (report 28 sits in REPORTS_WITHOUT_OBJECTIVES). The trial was filed by parser d5cef4939108bf28904728debe65f05b; every page answered 200 under both caps.
